name: Ecuador
summary: Yellow, blue and red horizontal bands, the yellow twice as tall, with the coat of arms in the centre. It shares the Gran Colombian colours with Colombia and Venezuela; the arms show a condor over Mount Chimborazo and the first steamship built in South America.
origin: Ecuador was part of Gran Colombia until 1830 and first used its yellow-blue-red tricolour. After several other designs, including a blue-and-white flag of the 1845 Marcist Revolution, the tricolour was readopted in 1860 by García Moreno.
A decree of 7 December 1900 confirmed the flag with the coat of arms in the centre.

colors.name: Yellow
colors.meaning: The fertility of the land, crops and mineral wealth.

colors.name: Blue
colors.meaning: The ocean and the clear sky.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The blood of those who died for independence.

symbols.name: Andean condor
symbols.description: A condor with spread wings atop an oval shield.
symbols.meaning: Power, greatness and strength; ready to attack any enemy.

symbols.name: Chimborazo and the river Guayas
symbols.description: A snow-capped volcano and a river with a steamship in the shield, under a sun and zodiac signs.
symbols.meaning: Ecuador's highest mountain and its coast. The ship is the Guayas, the first sea-going steamship built in South America (1841). The zodiac signs mark the months of the March Revolution of 1845.

symbols.name: Fasces and branches
symbols.description: A fasces below the shield, with laurel and palm branches and national flags.
symbols.meaning: Republican authority and dignity; laurel for victory and palm for peace.

facts: Without the arms it is identical to Colombia's flag except for proportions (1:2 for Ecuador, 2:3 for Colombia).
The civil flag, used by citizens, omits the coat of arms.
Ecuador's arms are among the few to depict a steamship.
clues: Yellow (double width), blue and red bands with a condor-topped coat of arms.
Its arms show a snow-capped volcano and an early steamship.
Without its arms, it closely resembles a neighbour's flag.
Zodiac signs on it mark the months of an 1845 revolution.
